verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents choosing a storage region or data residency for Portkey's hosted logs or other data. The closest items are adjacent and earn no credit: running the open-source gateway locally (portkey-docs-37) and routing requests to privately hosted models (portkey-docs-28). Neither is a documented region or residency selection for where Portkey stores data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
